newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-CROATIA V SLOVENIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA V SLOVENIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday' World Cup European group one qualifier between Croatia and Slovenia:

Croatia - 22-Tonci Gabric; 20-Dario Simic, 5-Nikola Jerkan, 6-Slaven Bilic, 7-Aljosa Asanovic, 8-Robert Prosinecki, 9-Goran Vlaovic, 10-Zvonimir Boban, 11-Alen Boksic, 25-Goran Juric, 21-Igor Cvitanovic
Slovenia - 1-Bosko Boskovic; 2-Robert Englaro, 4-Miran Srebrnic, 3-Ales Krizan, 5-Mladen Rudonja, 7-Dzoni Novak, 6-Ales Ceh, 9-Zlatko Zahovic, 8-Damjan Gajser, 11-Saso Udovic, 10-Primoz Gliha
